question: Is the automated generation and socket-test evidence sufficient to replace the shipped Android serialization boundary, or must this exact head show an Android emulator or device Gateway round trip before merge?
rationale: Automation cannot establish whether kotlinx.serialization, Android runtime behavior, and a real Gateway remain interoperable across the full changed wire boundary.

options.title: Require Android runtime proof
options.body: Require redacted emulator or device output showing connection, request/response, event receipt, and node invocation on the current head before merge.

options.title: Accept automated evidence
options.body: Merge based on deterministic generation, focused socket tests, and green Android CI while explicitly accepting the remaining runtime-compatibility uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require Android runtime proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted emulator or device output showing connection, request/response, event receipt, and node invocation on the current head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The review timeline identifies this person as the available Android-area routing candidate for the protocol-boundary decision.
